gloss: stationing (of troops); being stationed; military presence

definitions.gloss: stationing of military forces; maintaining a military presence in a location
definitions.explanation: The deployment and continued presence of military forces in a particular area, typically a foreign country. A common term in news about international military affairs.

examples.japanese: {米軍|べいぐん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駐留|ちゅうりゅう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: U.S. forces are stationed in Japan.

examples.japanese: {駐留|ちゅうりゅう}{軍|ぐん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{撤退|てったい}→撤退：12822_tettai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The withdrawal of the stationed forces was decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{駐留|ちゅうりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{巨額|きょがく}→巨額：12416_kyogaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧。
examples.english: The cost of overseas stationing amounts to an enormous sum every year.

notes:
Composed of {駐|ちゅう} (stationed, parked) + {留|りゅう} (stay, remain). Specifically refers to military forces being stationed in a location, usually abroad. One of the key terms for discussing U.S. military bases in Japan and other international security topics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐留|ちゅうりゅう}{軍|ぐん}: stationed forces
- {駐留|ちゅうりゅう}{米軍|べいぐん}: U.S. forces stationed (in Japan/abroad)
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{駐留|ちゅうりゅう}: overseas stationing
- {駐留|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧: stationing costs (host nation support)
- {駐留|ちゅうりゅう}⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧: stationing agreement (SOFA)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{駐屯|ちゅうとん}→駐屯：22864_chuuton⟧: garrisoning — more specifically about troops being quartered at a base or garrison
- ⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧: dispatch, deployment — the act of sending forces, rather than their continued presence
- ⟦{配備|はいび}→配備：25292_haibi⟧: deployment, positioning — placing military equipment or forces in strategic positions
